title: Paid design consultation to warm contacts
offer: Design Clarity Call: 90-minute consultation + one-page written brief, fee credited against a project signed within 90 days
buyer: home or small-commercial owner in Gujarat planning interiors, renovation or a small build within 6 months
channel: owner's warm WhatsApp network, one personal message per contact
hypothesis: Of the first 30 warm contacts personally messaged, at least 3 pay INR 2,499 through the payment link within 14 days of the first message.

decisions.SUCCESS: M0 recorded automatically. Open EXP-002 (consult -> first project stage, measures M1). Only now authorise T100 and apply incoming/plan-t100-go-public.json. No paid traffic until EXP-002 shows one conversion.
decisions.FAILURE_price: >=5 replies and top reason is price: run EXP-001b at INR 999, 30 new contacts, 14 days, once. T100 stays closed.
decisions.FAILURE_offer: <5 replies or top reason is no_need/timing: do not rerun. Open EXP-003 with a different buyer (small builders/developers, fixed-price 3D visualisation). T100 stays closed.
decisions.AMBIGUOUS: Extend once by 7 days to 60 contacts; then >=4 paid is SUCCESS, else FAILURE. Change nothing else.
decisions.BLOCKED: Fewer than 30 sent by day 7: not a market result. Record a hands-off gap (M3 wall). Next experiment must need under 3 owner-hours or delivery must be delegated first.

unknowns: contacts_available: how many warm contacts fit the buyer definition (owner counts, 10 min)
razorpay_live_mode: whether the Razorpay account is live and KYC-complete (owner checks dashboard, 2 min)
prior_consult_price: whether a paid consultation has been sold before and at what price (owner answers, 1 min)
delivered_by: owner or a staff architect (owner answers, 1 min)
public_presence: whether contacts can look the company up before paying (owner answers, 1 min)
